reason: The problem is real and the measurements are right; the proposed fix is wrong in both halves, and one half is actively harmful, so this is refuted as filed under the rule that a correct problem with a wrong fix is refuted with the corrected fix returned. PROBLEM, verified: lately.html:275-277 narrows .cols and .baseline to 57px and re-anchors .bar-val for .plot.solo, but leaves .xaxis (line 295, justify-content: space-between, padding-right: var(--gutter) 34px) and its span (line 296, flex: 1 1 0; text-align: center) untouched. The :only-child guard at lines 304-307 means the 560-900px tick-thinning rules never apply to the solo axis, so the single span stretches the full 652px and centres its text in the whole chart column. Driven in chromium at ?state=first-run, text centre measured with a Range against the bar's box centre: 1440 bar.cx 607.5 / text 905.0 = 297.5px; 1280 bar.cx 527.5 / text 825.0 = 297.5px; 768 157.5 / 395.0 = 237.5px; 390 69.5 / 178.0 = 108.5px. The seat's 298/238/109 are right; its '608 and 905' pair is the 1440 reading, not the 1280 one, and the dead width is 629px of a 686px track, not 631 of 688 — both immaterial. light-first-run--1440x960.png confirms the perceptual claim: a hatched column with '12 SO FAR' at the far left of the evidence field and '13 JUL' alone in open paper two-thirds of the way across, sitting over nothing. Class defect is correct: the axis is aria-hidden and the sr line at lately.html:953 carries the full spoken fact, so nothing untrue is asserted and no reader is misinformed - it is visibly uncomposed, not misleading. FIX, refuted: (1) '.chart:has(.plot.solo) { flex: 0 0 auto; align-self: start; }' is inert. .chart is a grid item of .hero (line 219, grid-template-columns: minmax(220px,300px) 1fr), not a flex item, so flex is ignored and align-self only touches the block axis. Injected and measured: chart.w stays 686, computed grid stays '300px 686px', card height stays 268.9 - a dead rule, and lessons.md already carries dead-rules as a found-and-fixed class. (2) The parenthetical alternative is worse than inert. 'minmax(220px, 300px) auto' still stretches the auto track under normal justify-content: injected at 1440 the chart stayed 686px and the label stayed at 905, delta unchanged at 297.5. At 390 the :has() override out-specifies the stacking rule at line 514 (.hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr }) and reinstates two columns: hero-fig 252px, chart 32px, the bar thrown to cx 345.5 and clipped. That is a mobile-layout break traded for a desktop no-op. (3) The rationale is false. 'the hero's text column takes the slack' cannot happen: the first track is hard-capped at 300px by minmax() and .hero-note is max-width: 30ch (line 229). fig.w measured 300px in every variant that rendered. Narrowing the chart only moves 629px of dead width from the middle of the card to its right edge. (4) The span override introduces a fresh error. With .xaxis at width 57px and the span at 'flex: 0 0 auto', space-between packs the shrunk ~34px span to flex-start, so the label lands 5.7px LEFT of the column centre at every width - measured delta -5.7 at both 1440 and 390. The span's existing 'flex: 1 1 0; text-align: center' is what makes it land exactly; the seat proposed removing the one declaration that was already correct.
sharpenedFix: One rule, no grid change, no span change: `.plot.solo ~ .xaxis { width: 57px; padding-right: 0; }`. The existing span keeps `flex: 1 1 0; text-align: center` and fills the 57px box, centring the tick on the 57px .cols track. Measured injected: text centre 607.5 vs bar centre 607.5 at 1440 and 69.5 vs 69.5 at 390 - delta 0.0 at every width, versus -5.7 for the seat's version and +297.5 today. The `~` combinator is valid here (.xaxis is a following sibling of .plot.solo inside .chart) and reaches no other axis, so the twelve-column charts in movement one and the age axis are untouched. Leave .chart and .hero alone: the empty right-hand field is the drawn-but-empty consequence of one week of data, and it is the correct place for the slack once the tick stands on its mark - the text column is capped at 300px/30ch and cannot absorb it, so any width surgery only relocates the emptiness while risking the 768/390 stack.
breaks: The sharpened one-liner is low-risk but re-measure: (a) the tick text at 390 - '13 Jul' is ~34px in Geist Mono at the label size and fits 57px, but a longer localised or two-digit-month start date could overflow a 57px box that no longer has 34px of gutter to bleed into, so check the widest fixture date at 390 and add `overflow: visible` if it clips; (b) the audit gate's type-ramp and leading checks on .xaxis span, since the box it lays out in changes; (c) interaction-check.mjs assertions that read .xaxis geometry in the first-run scope. If the seat's version is taken instead, re-measure the 390 and 768 stacked hero (the :has() override defeats the line 514 stacking rule), the card height at 1440, and every dead-rule check in the audit, since two of its three declarations compute to nothing.
